**1. Global Risk Regime?**

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Credit and volatility signals subdued: HYG ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.36% | 1M: +0.66%) and LQD ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.83% | 1M: +0.14%) indicate stable credit conditions, while VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -8.30% | 1M: -0.44%) ↓ falling points to softer realized fear.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Energy and Materials leading with clear upside: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.35% | 1M: +11.95%) and XME ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.03% | 1M: +18.98%); Tech also strong: XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.38% | 1M: +1.20%), while Financials XLF BELOW TREND (1W: -0.38% | 1M: -4.90%) shows relative weakness — style mixed with cyclicals and tech participation.

**5. US vs Global?**
EM leadership visible: EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.29% | 1M: +10.88%) and FXI ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.75% | 1M: +3.61%) outpacing SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.64% | 1M: +0.74%), signaling broad global risk appetite even as US remains constructive.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Selective speculation: IWM ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.82% | 1M: +4.76%) shows small‑cap involvement, ARKK RECOVERY (1W: +0.68% | 1M: -1.09%) and IBIT CORRECTION (1W: -0.26% | 1M: +2.37%) imply cautious, uneven speculative flows.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Precious metals leadership: SLV ABOVE TREND (1W: +18.97% | 1M: +55.77%) and GLD ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.89% | 1M: +15.58%), while copper CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.44% | 1M: +6.96%) supports industrial demand narratives.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy complex showing strength: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.35% | 1M: +11.95%), BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.51% | 1M: +9.44%) and UNG ABOVE TREND (1W: +18.84% | 1M: +18.64%) all rising.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Broad sector breadth (10/11) and major equity ETFs SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.64% | 1M: +0.74%) / QQQ ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.79% | 1M: +1.15%). DIVERGENCE: Tech ETF XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.38% | 1M: +1.20%) vs sector‑level Technology 1M weakness is a minor internal divergence to monitor.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor cyclicals and commodities exposure (XLE ABOVE TREND, XME ABOVE TREND, GLD ABOVE TREND, SLV ABOVE TREND) and monitor Financials XLF BELOW TREND (1W: -0.38% | 1M: -4.90%) and Communication where breadth is weak.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: SLV ABOVE TREND (1W: +18.97% | 1M: +55.77%), XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.35% | 1M: +11.95%). BEARISH: XLF BELOW TREND (1W: -0.38% | 1M: -4.90%), XLC RECOVERY (1W: +3.02% | 1M: -1.01%).

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: GLD ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.89% | 1M: +15.58%), UNG ABOVE TREND (1W: +18.84% | 1M: +18.64%). BEARISH: CORN RECOVERY (1W: +0.81% | 1M: -4.15%) — agricultural softening to monitor.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX ~20 (complacency threshold) with VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -8.30% | 1M: -0.44%); HYG/LQD ratio ~0.80 (credit health) with HYG ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.36% | 1M: +0.66%); XLK/XLF spread (watch pivot if XLK/XLF moves >2.0 differential) given XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.38% | 1M: +1.20%) vs XLF BELOW TREND (1W: -0.38% | 1M: -4.90%).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive, supporting broad participation despite neutral risk ratios. Energy, materials and precious metals showing relative strength (XLE, XME, GLD, SLV) while Financials and Communication show the key divergences to monitor.
